page_title: looot, one key for every data provider your agent needs

sources.entry: looot - One API key and prepaid balance for about 2,500 data endpoints: work email, phone, company enrichment, Google search, web pages. Add api.looot.ai/mcp as an MCP server in Claude, ChatGPT or Cursor. #paid #mcp

summary.name: looot
summary.one_liner: A single API key and prepaid balance that gives AI agents access to thousands of data APIs (enrichment, search, social, SEO) through one MCP server.
use_cases: Give an AI agent access to work email and phone lookups
Enrich company records from inside Claude or Cursor
Run Google searches and fetch web pages from an agent
Pay per call for data APIs without separate provider accounts
Connect data providers to Claude Code via MCP
summary.what_it_does: looot offers one API key and one prepaid balance for thousands of data endpoints from hundreds of providers, covering SEO, enrichment, and social data. It is designed to be used by AI agents through an MCP server at api.looot.ai/mcp, which can be added to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor. The page says the agent sees the price before each call and is charged only for calls that ran. The page includes a setup walkthrough for Claude Code that adds the HTTP MCP server, signs in through the browser, and checks connection status in /mcp. The page gives the endpoint counts inconsistently (4,200+ APIs in the page header, about 2,500 endpoints in the directory listing).
notable: Single key and balance across 300+ data providers
Agent sees the price before each call and pays only for calls that ran
Remote HTTP MCP server at api.looot.ai/mcp
Browser sign-in or token-based setup for Claude Code
caveats: Uses a prepaid balance, so usage costs money
Endpoint counts differ between the page header (4,200+) and the directory listing (about 2,500)
